name: CDC Diabetes Health Indicators: BRFSS Population Health Benchmark
description: The CDC Diabetes Health Indicators dataset from the UCI Machine Learning Repository (ID 891) is a population-scale public health benchmark derived from the Centers for Disease Control and Prevention (CDC) Behavioral Risk Factor Surveillance System (BRFSS) survey. Comprising 253,680 survey responses from US adults, the dataset incorporates 21 key health and lifestyle indicators: high blood pressure, high cholesterol, cholesterol check history, body mass index (BMI), smoking status, stroke history, heart disease or attack, physical activity, fruit consumption, vegetable consumption, heavy alcohol consumption, healthcare access, medical cost barrier, general health rating, mental health days, physical health days, difficulty walking, sex, age, education, and income. The benchmark supports population health modeling and diabetes risk stratification.
